policy.exact_profile_rule: Exact Cell_Profile counts require frozen non-synthetic source bytes plus Spiderweb-certified exact bindings. Runtime/template availability alone is insufficient.
policy.legacy_coordinate_rule: Legacy latitude/longitude fields are not exact unless per-record evidence explicitly establishes VERIFIED_SOURCE_COORDINATE or equivalent source geometry provenance.
policy.fixture_rule: tests, fixtures, samples, and conformance-only artifacts cannot satisfy a production migration denominator.
policy.null_semantics: NO_DATA != ZERO_RECORDS; ZERO_RECORDS requires verified coverage evidence.
policy.geometry_ownership: Spiderweb remains the sole canonical geometry authority; consumers are reference-only.
